topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It was a sunny day when I ran into Mark, the best friend of my childhood. We used to climb trees and build forts together, sharing every secret a 10-year-old could have. When I spotted him, a warm buzz filled my chest. I jogged over, grinning from ear to ear. "Mark, it’s been ages!" I exclaimed, hugging him tightly. He laughed, a little awkwardly, and said he’d been keeping busy. As we chatted, I shared memories, reliving those blissful days. His smile was polite, but his eyes told a different story. It didn’t matter though; it was amazing just to see him, to feel that connection, even if he didn’t remember it all. We promised to catch up soon, and as we parted, the day felt a little brighter, the world a little closer.
